basis: Phase 2.5 eligibility_rules_v1 harness; nominal ladders rescaled for pressure sample sizes (nominal, not validated). Search grids, not chosen cutoffs.

definition_grid.note: Pre-declared grid. 'any' = chase flag OR innings-1 flag at the same q. No definition outside the Stage 3 candidate set is used.

selection_rule.text: Population-level quantities only. A definition is viable when, for IPL and T20I and for batters and bowlers, a data-weight rule with a sufficient pool exists. Among viable definitions choose the highest q; ties go to the larger pressure population (sum of pressure unit rows over the four format-role cells). Player scores and rankings are never used; ranking stability is reported, not used.

baseline.primary: per-candidate baseline (pressure membership as finest level), leave-player-out

proxy.batter_unit: balls faced (excludes wide and Penalty), actual minus expected runs off the bat
proxy.bowler_unit: deliveries bowled (excludes Penalty), actual minus expected charged runs and wickets
proxy.batter_score: 100 x empirical-Bayes shrunk mean actual-minus-expected runs per ball (shrunk to the pooled sample mean)
proxy.bowler_score: -z(shrunk AvE charged runs) + z(shrunk AvE wicket rate), equal weights, arbitrary (Phase 2.5 convention)
